description: This PHP source file defines a subpanel view for displaying invitees (contacts and users) related to a Meeting module within SuiteCRM. It generates a form with buttons to select contacts and users via popup windows, and renders lists of invitees using XTemplate. The code manages the display of invitees associated with meetings in the CRM interface.

methods.name: get_form_header
methods.description: Generates the HTML header for the form displaying invitees, incorporating the title and buttons.
